description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint class CatalogBrandListEndpoint for listing catalog brands in the eShopOnWeb project. It sets up an HTTP GET route, interacts with a repository to retrieve catalog brand data, maps entities to DTOs, and returns the result.

classes.name: CatalogBrandListEndpoint
classes.description: API endpoint class for listing catalog brands, implementing minimal API pattern with routing, data retrieval, and response formatting.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Sets up the 'api/catalog-brands' GET route with associated handler and response configuration.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the request by retrieving catalog brands from repository, mapping them to DTOs, and returning the response.
